# Colchón Exprés

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Spanish mattress retailer (Pribucol S.A.) with an online store and nine physical shops in Madrid and Valladolid. Sells mattresses, bed bases, canapés, pillows, headboards and bedding accessories. Its own pages state distribution across the Peninsula and the Balearic Islands.
